brand.name: Elite Physicians Wealth Planning
brand.wordmark: Elite Physicians Wealth Planning™ — Powered by Fiscal Vision Financial
brand.location: Southern Maryland; public address must remain gated until White Plains versus Waldorf is authoritatively confirmed
brand.palette_guidance: Refined navy #0B1F3A, restrained gold #C8A65A, clinical mist blue #DCE8F2, warm ivory #F6F2E8, white, and charcoal #38373E. Gold is a measured coordination/accent signal, never casino styling. Preserve high contrast and avoid purple-blue SaaS gradients.
brand.voice: Professional, calm, precise, and physician-literate. Explain complex planning in plain language without sounding simplistic. Confident and coordinated rather than salesy, trendy, or alarmist.
brand.identity_belief: A physician’s financial life should work as one coordinated system rather than a set of isolated professional conversations.
brand.visual_metaphor: A single precise coordination line connects decisions that are usually handled in separate rooms.

typography.rule: These brand-specified families are fixed. Directional distinction must come from scale, case, weight, rhythm, and composition rather than substituting other families.

imagery.real_person_rule: NEUTRAL PLACEHOLDER ONLY in generated frames. The verified client portrait is placed at build time and must never be generated or face-swapped.
imagery.contextual_rule: Non-identifiable editorial scenes may show credible physicians or medical professionals in authentic workplace and planning contexts; they must not be presented as named staff.
imagery.avoid: No coins, handshakes, anonymous skyscrapers, generic market charts, fake staff, uncanny AI doctors, invented seals, or credential theater.

required_sections.name: The Separate Rooms Problem
required_sections.narrative_job: Visualize how fragmented advice creates planning gaps without implying that Michael personally holds every professional credential.

content.headline: Your financial life is too important to be managed in separate pieces.
content.body: Many physicians make decisions about taxes, retirement plans, investments, insurance, estate planning, student loans, and practice ownership in separate conversations with separate professionals. Our role is to help bring the strategy together.
content.boundary_note: Coordination does not mean one person performs every professional service.

required_sections.composition_intent: A visual coordination map should reveal the gap between separate professional rooms and one set of physician priorities; it must be explanatory, not decorative.

required_sections.name: The Wealth Blueprint™
required_sections.narrative_job: Turn the named six-phase planning process into a memorable mechanism that feels continuous rather than a generic six-card grid.

content.headline: A planning system built to move with your career.
content.body: A structured process designed to help busy medical professionals identify planning gaps, prioritize action steps, coordinate advisors, and update the plan as career, family, income, and tax laws change.

phases.name: Discover
phases.summary: Learn your goals, priorities, income structure, benefits, and current decisions.

phases.name: Assess
phases.summary: Evaluate how the financial pieces interact and where gaps remain.

phases.name: Strategize
phases.summary: Build one connected plan across the decisions that matter.

phases.name: Implement
phases.summary: Organize action steps and coordinate the appropriate professionals.

phases.name: Optimize
phases.summary: Monitor changes in income, family, practice, markets, and tax rules.

phases.name: Review
phases.summary: Keep the plan aligned, current, and actionable over time.

required_sections.composition_intent: One continuous route carries the eye through all six phases; the process must not collapse into six equal floating cards.

viewport_contract.rule: Primary content fits the design frame; supporting closure may continue below the browser fold; section entry and exit space stays outside primary content groups.

motif_continuity: A precise gold coordination line exits 01-one-plan at the lower right and crosses into 02-career-signal at the same position.
The line exits 02-career-signal at lower center and enters 03-separate-rooms as a restrained transition marker rather than restarting.
The line enters 03-separate-rooms at upper center, separates into the professional-role paths, and reunites at the bottom-left seam into 04-blueprint-rounds.
The line traverses 04-blueprint-rounds as the six-phase route and ends at the lower-right edge; 05-five-decisions begins with the same endpoint as a ledger rule.
The ledger rule leaves 05-five-decisions at lower left and becomes the indexing rail at the upper-left of 06-white-coat-paths.
The indexing rail exits 06-white-coat-paths at lower right and enters 07-accountable-planner behind the portrait placeholder as a quiet accountability line.
The line exits 07-accountable-planner at lower center and divides into the two honest next-step paths in 08-next-decision.
rhythm_rules: Use at least five materially different composition anchors across the eight sections.
At most two sections may use an eyebrow, oversized headline, then cards silhouette.
02-career-signal is a short 1536x512 strip, never a full-height section.
05-five-decisions and 07-accountable-planner are quiet sections with conspicuous negative space and smaller headline scale.
03-separate-rooms and 04-blueprint-rounds may be diagram-forward, but their diagrams must use different geometries and reading directions.
Only one section may use a conventional left-text/right-image split, and 06-white-coat-paths must not be a uniform card grid.
Use no decorative folio numbering beyond the functional six-phase process numbers in 04-blueprint-rounds.
The final page must feel like one guided consultation, not eight self-contained presentation slides.

hard_rules: The existing logo and wordmark are fixed assets and are never redesigned, restyled, re-lettered, or reinterpreted. Generated frames use plain type or a neutral reserved logo area; the real approved logo is placed at build time.
Do not use the outdated Fiscal Vision logo as the final Elite Physicians Wealth Planning identity without explicit approval.
Use only the brand-specified Cormorant Garamond and Inter families; direction variation may change typographic voice through scale, case, weight, rhythm, and placement, not family substitution.
Use refined navy, restrained gold, mist blue, warm ivory, white, and charcoal. No purple-blue SaaS gradients, oversaturated gold, black-and-gold casino styling, or invented accent hues.
Michael A. Epps and all named staff are never generated. Reserve neutral placeholders for the real build-time client portraits.

Non-identifiable contextual medical professionals may be generated only when the scene is credible, documentary, and clearly not presented as named staff. Reject uncanny faces, impossible anatomy, or fake clinical detail.
Do not invent testimonials, ratings, performance results, fees, AUM, licenses, fiduciary status, professional designations, badges, awards, regulatory claims, team biographies, or credentials.
Michael A. Epps may be identified only with the verified ChFC® and RICP® designations. Do not imply he is a CPA, attorney, tax-return preparer, or estate-document drafter.
Elite Physicians Wealth Planning coordinates strategy and professional resources; it does not claim to perform unverified tax preparation, legal drafting, or CPA services.
The tax-planning guide remains gated and contingent on the customer supplying the final guide and approved delivery workflow; never show it as immediately downloadable.
Use info@fiscalvisionfinancial.com as the public contact email. Do not reproduce the incorrect reference-site email.
The intended launch domain is elitephysicianswealthplanning.com with the added s; the singular domain is reference-only.
Do not show a public street address until the White Plains versus Waldorf discrepancy is authoritatively resolved.
Do not clone the current Lovable site, preserve its thin structure, or treat its generated visuals as immutable art direction.
No generic finance visuals dominated by coins, handshakes, anonymous skyscrapers, market charts, laptop dashboards, or decorative numbers that could be mistaken for financial data.
Do not make every section a generic card grid, rounded-card collection, or centered text stack.
Any control-like element must have an explicit useful outcome in functional_elements; otherwise render it as static content.
Use the continuous coordination line as a structural motif with the exact seam behavior in page_flow; it must not restart independently inside every frame.
Functional process numbers 01–06 are allowed only in 04-blueprint-rounds; decorative folio numbers are prohibited elsewhere.
All primary content groups and complete focal subjects must fit inside the 1536x864 composition target; the coded section may extend only with intentional entry or exit space outside those groups.
